name: Learning Multiple-Scattering Solutions for Sphere-Tracing
definition: A method that learns a geometric approximation of random paths in a homogeneous volume to determine absorption and direct lighting contributions, bypassing lengthy internal scattering processes by summarizing many scattering events into a single sphere-tracing step.
summary: This method accelerates volumetric path tracing by using neural networks to approximate multiple scattering events within a single sphere-tracing step, avoiding the computational cost of simulating individual internal scattering interactions.
